meta.title: Suggestions Register — review before implementing
workflow: 1. PROPOSED — anyone (or an agent session) adds a suggestion with evidence and expected decision impact.
2. REVIEWED — a human reviewer compares suggestions side by side on the same page and picks a path.
3. ACCEPTED / REJECTED / DEFERRED — the reviewer records a decision and notes. Only ACCEPTED items may be implemented.
4. IMPLEMENTED — a change is made in a later, separately claimed task; the suggestion links to the commit/PR.
meta.rule: Nothing in this register is implemented automatically. The site exists to help a reviewer choose the best path first (R3). Statuses below are the agent's proposals; the reviewer is the owner.

suggestions.title: Decision cockpit: every decision shows evidence, open questions and a recommendation
suggestions.problem: Findings are scattered; a reviewer cannot see what a decision rests on.
suggestions.proposal: A decision page per major decision listing: options, supporting rows with source links, blocking questions (Q-ids), and a labelled recommendation with confidence.
suggestions.impact: Faster, auditable decisions; nothing decided while blocking questions are open.
suggestions.evidence: This suite implements the first version (nfl-analytics.html, questions.html).

suggestions.title: Scheduled refresh of all verified data (cron CI)
suggestions.problem: Injuries/standings/results go stale within days; Q20.
suggestions.proposal: Add a cron schedule to .github/workflows/nfl-analytics.yml (e.g., 12:00 UTC daily + Sunday morning) so snapshots and the tracker refresh with no manual input (R13).
suggestions.impact: The tracker stays current; deficiencies flagged automatically.
suggestions.evidence: scripts/fetch_nfl_analytics.py exists; only the trigger schedule is missing.

suggestions.title: Timestamped, immutable pick ledger (pre-kickoff lock)
suggestions.problem: Without pre-kickoff locks, results cannot be separated from luck (R10).
suggestions.proposal: Each submitted pick is written as an immutable JSON line with submission timestamp; grading uses only picks timestamped before kickoff.
suggestions.impact: Removes back-fitting; enables honest skill measurement.
suggestions.evidence: Standard contest practice; required by gates G1/G6 in strategies.html.

suggestions.title: Market snapshot job (open + close odds capture)
suggestions.problem: Q4/Q5/Q17: no verified market lines/props; CLV gate impossible.
suggestions.proposal: Extend the CI fetcher to capture a timestamped market reference (ESPN BET partner feed, or a licensed book source the owner designates) at line open and at close for every graded game.
suggestions.impact: Enables edge, CLV and hold-aware grading; unlocks prop strategies.
suggestions.evidence: espn.com/nfl/odds attempted 2026-11-13 (market-odds file states the outcome).
suggestions.risk: source reliability; must stay labelled non-official

suggestions.title: Correlation job for parlays and player-prop combos
suggestions.proposal: Once >=50 graded same-game samples exist, compute the empirical leg-outcome correlation matrix (binary-outcome phi coefficients) and publish it beside the literature ranges.
suggestions.impact: Parlay/prop-combo staking stops relying on assumed correlation.
suggestions.risk: small-sample noise — shrink toward 0 with a documented prior

suggestions.title: Parse official gamebooks for play-level and usage data
suggestions.problem: Q3/Q15/Q19: no EPA/snap/targets from official sources.
suggestions.proposal: NFL.com publishes official gamebooks (PDF) and player stat pages; a parser can extract snap counts, targets and red-zone plays without inventing anything.
suggestions.impact: Sharper prop baselines and totals models.

suggestions.title: Game-day inactives + transactions ingestion
suggestions.problem: Q6/Q14: designations lag; IR moves change depth within hours.
suggestions.proposal: Fetch nfl.com/transactions and the official inactives release 90 minutes pre-kickoff; re-run the deficiency report automatically.
suggestions.impact: The tracker reflects actual game-day lineups (2nd/3rd/4th string reality).
suggestions.evidence: Willis IR news (nfl.com) shows the gap this week.

suggestions.title: Provenance badge on every value everywhere
suggestions.problem: R16: reviewers must instantly see verified vs derived vs blank.
suggestions.proposal: Keep the three-state pattern used here (official link / MODEL OUTPUT / blank+flag) site-wide, including generated pages.
suggestions.impact: Prevents inferred values from slipping into decisions.

suggestions.title: Model-vs-market calibration report per week
suggestions.problem: An originated line has no accuracy feedback loop.
suggestions.proposal: After each week, publish: model spread/total vs market (when available) vs final score; rolling MAE of the model, bias per team.
suggestions.impact: Validates the origination engine; feeds validation gates G4/G5.
suggestions.evidence: Week 10 TNF (WAS 24 @ NYG 21) is the first settled test point.

suggestions.title: Pre-decision checklist (definition of done)
suggestions.problem: Decisions risk being made on partial evidence.
suggestions.proposal: Before any implementation: every blocking question answered or waived in writing; every data row sourced; suggestions compared; reviewer signs off in COORDINATION.md.

suggestions.title: Weekly postmortem log (model + strategies)
suggestions.problem: Errors repeat without a learning loop.
suggestions.proposal: One dated log entry per week: biggest miss, data gap exposed, one corrective action with owner approval.

suggestions.title: Exposure controls on the leaderboard
suggestions.problem: A lucky all-in run can top a naive ROI table.
suggestions.proposal: Hard caps: max 3% bankroll per pick, max 10% weekly exposure, correlated-stack cap (see correlation table), and skill-adjusted scoring (leaderboard.html).
suggestions.impact: Rewards repeatable skill, not one parlay (R10).

suggestions.title: Depth-chart drift monitor
suggestions.problem: Q7/Q8: club depth charts change silently.
suggestions.proposal: Diff each club's depth chart week over week; publish changed rows with both snapshot links.
suggestions.impact: Catches when a 'backup' becomes a starter between reports.
suggestions.evidence: Snapshots are now captured weekly by the CI fetcher.

suggestions.title: Data-gap dashboard (auto-list unverified cells)
suggestions.problem: Flagged items are easy to forget.
suggestions.proposal: A generated page listing every blank/unverified cell in the current week's tables with the question it blocks.
suggestions.impact: Missing information stays visible until resolved (R4/R16).

suggestions.title: Luck-adjusted scoring: shrinkage + bootstrap + CLV
suggestions.proposal: Score = shrunk ROI (Bayesian shrink toward 0) + CLV bonus, published with a 95% bootstrap interval; ranks require the interval to clear zero to earn rewards.
